summary: Genius Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the consummation of a public offering of common shares and pre-funded warrants on April 16, 2026. The offering consisted of 2,297,297 ordinary shares at $0.37 per share and up to 19,324,324 pre-funded warrants at $0.3699 each (exercise price $0.0001). D. Boral Capital acted as exclusive placement agent, receiving a 7% cash fee and 1% expense allowance. Gross proceeds were $8 million, with $5.5 million used to fund a senior secured acquisition. Lock-up agreements apply to insiders for 30 days and the company for two months. This is a routine capital raise, not a special-situation event.
